items.name: Bremium Cubing 2026
items.information:
As always, we are happy to welcome a lot of competitors at the fifth edition of Bremium Cubing!


Wir freuen uns über zahlreiche Anmeldungen für die fünfte Ausgabe der Bremium Cubing!

items.name: Arkansas Championship 2026
items.information:
This competition is supported by [Southern Cubing](https://southerncubing.com/) as the Arkansas State Championship for 2026!

While only residents of Arkansas are eligible for the title of Arkansas State Champion, all competitors are welcome and encouraged to compete! More information can be found on the [Arkansas Champion Titles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArkansasChampionship2025#52514-arkansas-champion-titles) tab.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTUxMjY0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ba8cf400c90970b89cbba5cfb8075de64f93272e/image.png)

To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
